notes.subject: וירד
notes.rationale: Qere irĩtwo ta 'agathamakia' (nĩgũthamakia) na Ketib 'arũgamĩra' — andũ a taũri mehikanagia kana nĩ 'mũthamaki ũrĩa ũrũgamaga kuuma Yaakobu' kana 'nĩngũrũgama athamakia'.

notes.subject: ⟨mũthamaki⟩
notes.rationale: Kĩgomanĩro kĩa andũ gĩa Kĩhibirania kĩiyũrĩtwo nĩ mũthamaki ũmwe; kiugo 'mũndũ/mũthamaki' kĩongĩtwo kũgĩa mũgambi wa gĩcunjĩ kĩa mbere.

notes.subject: mucĩ
notes.rationale: 'Mucĩ' ũrĩa wothe ũtaũrĩtwo ũkĩhoro ũhoro wa kũmana kwa andũ aria mathamakĩte nĩ Yaakobu — kiugo gĩtarĩ kĩmwe kĩoneretagĩrĩra andũ arĩa me hau.

translation: Na kuuma kwa Yaakobu nĩngũrũgama ⟨mũthamaki⟩, na nĩngĩhithithia mũciookia wa ⟨mucĩ⟩.
